title.value: Disentanglement of Correlated Factors via Hausdorff Factorized Support
title.justification: The title accurately represents the paper's focus on disentangling correlated factors using the Hausdorff Factorized Support method.
title.quote: D ISENTANGLEMENT OF C ORRELATED FACTORS VIA H AUSDORFF FACTORIZED S UPPORT

extractions.description: This paper introduces a method called Hausdorff Factorized Support (HFS) for disentangling correlated factors in deep learning models. The method relaxes the assumption of statistical independence among factors and instead uses a pairwise factorized support criterion to handle correlations. The approach leads to significant improvements in disentanglement and robust generalization across distribution shifts. The authors demonstrate the effectiveness of HFS through extensive experiments, indicating its potential applications in representation learning and transfer to downstream tasks.
